cases.integrationContract: Current review and private dataReported access, visibility and consent are supplied claims. A resolved callback does not grant or revoke access, send a context payload or change that report. Approval needs fresh current scopes and acknowledgement; context handoff needs a fresh complete-preview acknowledgement. Replacing the report or callback clears the draft and fences obsolete responses.Callbacks contain current component, report and action IDs/revisions, plus approved scope or planned section IDs/revisions. Values, labels, purposes, recipients, counts and exclusion reasons stay outside those intents. JSON regions expose every supplied value for keyboard reading; zero, false, null and absent counts stay distinct.Server-only and excluded entries accept metadata only. Keep actual server-only values out of the client payload. Visibility labels and catalogue security declarations do not enforce isolation. The structured-result helper includes its supplied data without automatic redaction; never place private review values in model-visible structuredContent or content.The server example prepares separate model-safe metadata and a private app payload. Route the private payload through your host's approved private app channel and enforce authorization before any operation. This preparation does not send data, register a tool or configure a host policy.
